discoverySummary.deloitteOutcome: Deloitte: no new verified fresher-eligible role. The exact current Deloitte Associate Analyst Application Support requisition inspected required a minimum of two years and was excluded.
discoverySummary.shortfall: Priority saved 3 technical full-time, 2 non-technical full-time and 2 internship/training roles; technical full-time is short by 3. Backup saved 2 internship/training roles; it is short by 6 technical full-time and 2 non-technical full-time. Blocked, location-inconclusive, experience-required and duplicate postings were not used as fillers.

ranking.policy: Deloitte first, then approved 87 employers, then source-complete fallback employers. One normalized employer across Priority and Backup.
